rows.grounds: compound: eka-akṣara, qualifying the mantra context
past passive participle of ud-vad (to speak, declare)

items.question: What practices are declared in connection with the one-syllable mantra?
premises: Meditation, worship, preliminary rites, and related practices are specified.
These practices are associated with a one-syllable formulation.
The text explicitly declares this association.
items.inference: The one-syllable mantra entails the prescribed set of meditation, worship, and preliminary rites.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ekākṣara (which specific syllable) is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Meditation, worship, preliminary rites, and so forth are declared for the one-syllable mantra.
